title: Where the river takes flight
description: Rising spray carries the player through tall shafts; control the sideways exit onto dry ledges.

signs.text: Jump into the spray · steer onto the dry ledge
Cross the dry arch crowns between the falls
Let the spray do the climbing
Descend through the dry chambers behind the falls
Exit each column before the next stone wall
Leave these falls to the left before crossing to the next outlet
Ride the final cascade towards the spring gate
